newsitem.title: USA: CN Biosciences files for stock offering.
newsitem.headline: CN Biosciences files for stock offering.

text.p: CN Biosciences Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday for an offering of 1.0 million shares of common stock, including 910,190 shares to be sold by on of its stockholders.
The stockholder, Baltimore-based ABS MB (C-N) Limited Partnership is selling its entire 17.6 percent stake.
Proceeds from the sale of the 89,810 shares offered by the company would be used for working capital, general coporate purposes and possible acquistions, it said.
Underwriters UBS Securities and Dain Bosworth Inc. have an over-allotment option to buy up to 150,000 addtional shares, it said.
